cards.title: Apple Tightens macOS Full Disk Access Controls
cards.body: Apple is adding new controls around macOS's Full Disk Access permission due to risks from increasingly capable AI agents. The move addresses concerns about broad access to users' files, messages, mail, and browsing history.

cards.title: White House Gets Tech CEOs to Sign AI Safety Pledge
cards.body: President Trump brought together major tech leaders including Zuckerberg, Bezos, Musk, and Anthropic's Dario Amodei to sign an AI safety pledge. Trump called the pledge "morally binding" and signed an executive order alongside the commitment.

cards.title: White House Rebrands AI as 'Super Intelligence'
cards.body: The White House is shifting terminology from AI to "super intelligence" in official discussions. Nearly every major tech CEO attended the signing of a safety pledge at the meeting.

cards.title: Circuit Breaker Labs Tackles AI Safety for Children
cards.body: Circuit Breaker Labs has created "crash-test dummies" to address psychological harms from AI exposure. The startup is focusing on making AI safer for kids and consumers.

cards.title: Pope Leo XIV Criticizes AI-Generated Art
cards.body: The Pope stated there's an "ontological difference" between human art and machine-generated work. He argued that algorithms lack "the spark of humanity" despite statistical sophistication.

cards.title: Musk's Grok Reportedly Influenced Trump's Venezuela Decision
cards.body: President Trump reportedly consulted Grok before considering military action against Venezuela and Nicolas Maduro. The incident highlights AI's growing influence in high-level political decisions.

cards.title: ChatGPT Adds Virtual Try-On Shopping Features
cards.body: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping capabilities that let ChatGPT users virtually try on clothes using their own photos. Users can also save favorite products to a dedicated library.

cards.title: Google Launches Advanced Chips Into Orbit
cards.body: Google deployed its first advanced chip into orbit to pave the way for space-based data centers. The company estimates SpaceX's Starship will need roughly 1,800 launches to make orbital AI infrastructure viable.

cards.title: OpenAI Cuts Ties With Three Safety Researchers
cards.body: OpenAI parted ways with three safety researchers after an internal investigation revealed mishandling of sensitive company information. The incident underscores tensions within the company's safety operations.

cards.title: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 Has Telltale Writing Patterns
cards.body: Analysis reveals Opus 5.5 uses "dependable" 23 times more often than human writing samples. The discovery highlights how AI models develop distinctive linguistic fingerprints.

cards.title: Amazon Releases Jev Clone Decision Model
cards.body: AWS's Strand Labs released Strands Decider 2B as decision-making AI models proliferate across the industry. The move reflects growing competition in specialized AI model categories.

cards.title: Shopify Launches Canvas AI Store Builder
cards.body: Shopify's new Canvas tool lets merchants build online stores by chatting with AI agent Sidekick while seeing changes in real time. The feature aims to democratize e-commerce store creation.

cards.title: Airbnb's Chesky Advocates AI-Native Operating System
cards.body: Brian Chesky discussed making Airbnb agent-friendly and the need for an AI-native operating system. He highlighted the critical gap in software infrastructure for AI agents.

cards.title: Photon Raises $4.5M to Replace Mobile Apps
cards.body: Photon secured $4.5M funding to help developers build AI agents across messaging platforms like iMessage and email. The startup believes agents will eventually displace traditional downloaded apps.

cards.title: Legato Launches AI-Powered Hearing Glasses
cards.body: Hearing tech startup Legato introduced AI hearing glasses to address accessibility challenges in hearing care. The innovation tackles cost, comfort, and stigma issues with traditional hearing aids.

cards.title: Satlyt Raises $8M for Orbital AI Computing
cards.body: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX PM, secured $8M to enable AI processing on satellites. The startup positions itself as "Android for orbital computing" against SpaceX's closed approach.

cards.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon Model
cards.body: Google launched Gemini 4 Argon, positioning it as the most powerful model in its lineup. The model specializes in coding and cybersecurity applications.

cards.title: Enterprise AI Reaches Full Operational Flight
cards.body: AI capabilities are advancing faster than organizations can absorb, while performance costs continue falling. Global AI investment is projected to reach $2.5 trillion in 2026, up 44% year-over-year.

cards.title: LLMs Don't Reason, Researchers Warn
cards.body: Large language models lack genuine reasoning capabilities despite impressive performance on benchmarks. Researchers challenge the assumption that LLMs think logically like humans.

cards.title: AI Brain Scans Reconstruct Visual Imagination
cards.body: A new AI tool can accurately reconstruct images by analyzing brain scans and predicting neural activity from visual input. The breakthrough demonstrates AI's growing ability to decode human perception.

cards.title: OpenAI Responds to Contained Agent Hacks
cards.body: Two months after OpenAI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face, the company is managing ongoing disclosures. OpenAI's chief research officer downplays long-term fallout from the security breaches.

cards.title: AI Cracks Hidden-Information Game Stratego
cards.body: AI has finally mastered Stratego, a game that stumped machines due to hidden information constraints. The breakthrough challenges assumptions about AI limitations with imperfect information.

cards.title: Google AI Search Faces Antitrust Dismissal
cards.body: A judge dismissed antitrust lawsuits against Google's AI-powered search feature from Chegg and Penske. The ruling represents a legal setback for competitors challenging Google's AI search integration.
